sum_insured_options: ₹5L – ₹20L (based on sub-limit table; exact range not fully stated)

room_rent.note: Standard A/C room (single occupancy with attached washroom, excludes suite). Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken.

icu.note: ICU expenses paid at actuals as per policy wording Section C1(b).

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay in base plan. Voluntary co-pay of 5%/10%/15%/20% can be opted for premium discount. If 'Cashless Discount' optional cover is opted, 20% co-pay applies on reimbursement claims.

sub_limits.note: Inbuilt cataract sub-limit: 10% of SI per eye, max ₹50,000. Optional 'Procedure/Disease Sub-limit' cover adds caps on cardiac, joints, hernia, calculi, hysterectomy, spine, cancer, etc.

deductible.note: No mandatory deductible in base plan. Voluntary aggregate deductible of ₹10,000–₹3,00,000 can be opted for premium discount.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 36 months from first policy inception. Reducible via portability credit.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month waiting for listed conditions including cataract, hernia, calculi, hysterectomy, organ transplant, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered. No optional maternity add-on mentioned.

cumulative_bonus.note: CB increases 10% of base SI per claim-free year, max 100%. Reduces at same rate on claim. Optional 'Super Cumulative Bonus' add-on offers up to 200% at 25–50%/yr.

restoration.note: Sum Insured Reinstatement is an optional cover. Options: once per policy year or unlimited times per policy year. Subsequent hospitalisation must be after 2-day gap from discharge (waived for different insured person). Not available for organ donor or modern treatment claims.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Extensive indicative list of 399+ procedures provided. Any procedure requiring <24 hrs due to technology advances also covered.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to SI if patient cannot be moved or no hospital room available, must exceed 3 days. Several conditions excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, vector-borne, etc.).

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation covered up to In-patient SI. Requires minimum 24-hour admission. OPD and comfort treatments excluded.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor harvesting expenses covered up to In-patient SI. Pre/post-hospitalisation for donor not covered. Restoration benefit not applicable.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered at reasonable & customary charges up to In-patient SI for emergency transfer and inter-hospital transfer.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, intra-vitreal injections, stem cell for haematological conditions, etc.) covered up to In-patient SI. CB and restoration not applicable for this cover.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items listed in Annexure II are excluded. No optional consumables rider mentioned.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers treatment within India only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no look-back applied. Claims not contestable except for fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for quarterly/half-yearly/annual premium; 15 days for monthly instalment.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from receipt of policy document at inception only (not on renewal or porting).

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: No overseas treatment, no maternity, domiciliary excludes diabetes/hypertension/asthma/epilepsy, no consumables cover, terrorism covered

optional_riders.display: Sum Insured Reinstatement (once/unlimited), Super Cumulative Bonus (up to 200%), Disease Sub-limits, Accidental Death Cover, Cashless Discount, No Claim Discount
